note: A leased provincial recreation site on the NE shore of Chitek Lake run by the Resort Village of Chitek Lake: a main electric campground and the smaller Pelican Beach area beside the sand beach about 600 m west, with a swim beach, boat launch and playground. Mostly seasonal: about 21 of its 64 sites are sold by the night; 40 go to seasonal campers by draw. The lakefront sites sold by the night are at Pelican Beach (56-58); the main campground's shore row is seasonal. --Claude
summary: Keep for the reviewer (mostly seasonal, not iffy). Resort Village of Chitek Lake runs it (leased provincial rec site, confirmed by Tourism SK + the village). 64 sites: 40 seasonal by draw, 21 sold by the night on Let's Camp (incl. site 60, a camp-kitchen/overflow spot) - ~33%. Posted 2026 nightly rates C$35 + GST electric / C$25 non-electric; Google 4.2 (52). Two-night minimum (under 3). Lakefront kept but now rests on Pelican Beach nightly sites 56-58, not the seasonal main-campground shore row. Water/sewer false (taps + dump; Let's Camp's site flags are wrong). Pin kept.
flags: LONG-STAY: nightly share ~21 of 64 (~33%). Let's Camp sells 21 site records: main campground 15B, 22, 30, 40A, 40B, 41, 43; Pelican Beach 46-52 (incl. 50A/50B, no 53), 54-58 and 60 (60 described 'CAMP KITCHEN RENTAL/OVERFLOW'). Operator: 'A total of 40 seasonal sites will be available ... Awarding of these sites will be through a Draw system to be done on MARCH 31, 2027, remaining sites will then be available for weekly reservations.' Not iffy: posted 2026 nightly rates, site count, live online booking, Google 4.2 (52). No wording discouraging nightly guests; standing minimum is 2 nights (the first two weeks of the booking window take 6-night+ stays only).

WATERFRONT: lakefront kept (stored, not --AWH), but on different sites than the stored evidence. The main campground's lake row (sites 1-9 on the paper map; the 2020 rundown calls 1-7 'Lake Front') is not sold by the night. Nightly lakefront: Pelican Beach sites 56, 57 (non-electric, 32 ft) and 58 (30 A) on the lake side of the west loop, ~53.7569,-107.7634, ~30-40 m from the waterline over lawn and sand beach with scattered birch (Esri z17); the Let's Camp photo of site 57 shows the lake and shore reeds across open grass. Site 59 (same row) is seasonal. The main campground's shore row (1-9) is seasonal. -> lakefront'.

The village says 30 or 50 A; every nightly site is 30 A on Let's Camp (the 2020 rundown gives 50 A to shore sites 1-3/5 and a 50 A upgrade on 39 and 41) - set 30.
